kitDescription: Mary: Bay Goddess is a Water Burst-I supporter whose own damage is negligible; her value is team support. Each time the team enters Full Burst she heals all allies over 5 seconds, and the heal strengthens with each subsequent Full Burst entry (all earlier tiers keep firing alongside the new one). Each time she personally casts her Burst Skill, she grants all Water-Code allies an escalating Elemental-Advantage Attack Damage buff (20.85%/3s, then adding 13.88%/5s, then 8.36%/10s, stacking cumulatively). Her burst itself gives Water-Code allies +23.23% ATK for 3 seconds and raises every ally's Max HP by 27.87% of her own Max HP for 10 seconds. All of her buffs are scoped: the offensive lines reach Water allies only, the HP line reaches everyone.

S1 (Full-Burst entry) grants NO stat buff — it is a heal only (run-A mary-casterIdx zero assertion)

verdictRationale: No real gotchas. All four load-bearing kit lines are FAITHFUL: triggers (fullBurstEnter vs burstCast — two genuinely distinct escalating counters), targets (Water-only S2/ATK vs all-allies S1-heal/HP), values, durations, and escalation semantics (cumulative steps 1..N, cap 3) match the prose, and every line fires at its prose cadence over 180s (9 FB entries for S1; >2 own casts for S2/burst, fixture-sanity-asserted). Convergence is strong where it counts: the S6 blind override is byte-equal to the driver's, and 8/8 substantive S5 assertions pass against the shipped override. The mechanical S5 run is RED on 2 assertions, but both trace to a single blind fixture-premise error — the assumption that liter monopolizes every B1 window in controlComp so Mary never casts — which the engine disproves (both B1s cast alternately; Mary casts 7×). That is a RECON_ERROR in the blind test, not a driver divergence; the driver's own fixture (Mary as sole B1) is the design S2b's note 1 explicitly demanded. The heal-magnitude ladder (1.05/3.69/6.86%) is a documented gap (no HP pool; recovery-event count preserved), flagged by driver, S5 (it.skip), and S6 alike. Discrimination is genuine: the driver ships counterfactual arms for every nearest-wrong (single-tier, unscoped ×2, targetMaxHpPct, instant-heal, single-heal, no-S1, Iron-boss inertness), and S2d shows the suite RED before the override existed. Same-model residuals the owner should spot-check: (1) the SSOT's internal tension on elemAdvantageDamagePct bucket placement (damage-calculation.md §1c places it in the element multiplier; game-mechanics.md §10 and the driver note say Damage-Up) — behavior tested here is identical under either, the divergence is stacking-magnitude-only and owner/measurement-gated; (2) S6's ⚑ that same-caster same-stat escalating steps could overwrite rather than co-stack — empirically refuted in this run (all three tier values and durations observed co-active, per-FB recovery count reaches ≥10), so the bar is met, but it is the kind of engine-shared prior worth one glance; (3) the driver's own datamine cadence ⚑s (pullsPerSec, reloadFrames 111, bolt-gap) affect only her negligible personal damage.
